about-info-1: Hi, I'm Victor Alan Carvajal Dominguez, a graduate from the Instituto Tecnológico de Sonora where I started my journey in 2018. Since 2020, I've been deeply immersed in the world of programming and web development, gaining extensive experience through freelance projects and internships. After graduation, I transitioned into remote roles at various companies, where I've continued to grow and refine my skills in building modern web applications.
about-info-2: I consider myself a self-taught person who loves constant learning. Every day I seek to expand my knowledge, whether it's exploring new technologies or mastering better development practices. This mindset has helped me stay adaptable and continuously improve as a developer.
about-info-3: My professional journey has taken me through diverse projects and environments, from freelance work that taught me to adapt to different client needs, to remote positions at companies where I've collaborated with teams across the globe. These experiences have shaped me into a versatile developer who can tackle challenges with creativity and precision.

services-questions-1: What is a responsive web page?
services-questions-p1: It is that page that is capable of adapting to any device where it is viewed, such as cell phones, tablets, laptops, without losing appearance or usability.
services-questions-2: What is a Domain and a Hosting?
services-questions-p2: Both are essential elements of a website. In short, the domain name is the address of the web page, while the hosting provides the space and resources necessary to launch the website.
